title: Bulk upsert with explicit conflict column policy
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag an upsert with an empty update_columns list as a no-op bug. It is the explicit policy the caller chose -- insert new rows, change nothing on conflict -- and the returned counts still report the conflict as an update encounter so callers can distinguish it from an insert.
